subject: [PATCH 29/60] mm: keep private memory out of the system memory totals

reviews.author: Gregory Relay
reviews.summary: Reviewer noted that the patch does not address private memory being counted in vmstat counters and per-node meminfo, which could lead to inaccurate system memory totals.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch modifies the Linux kernel to exclude private memory from system memory totals, ensuring that only general-purpose memory is counted in metrics such as totalram_pages() and nr_free_pages(). This change affects various parts of the kernel, including overcommit limits, OOM capacity, tmpfs, zswap defaults, and several other metrics. The patch also updates several readers to use nr_free_pages() instead of NR_FREE_PAGES directly.
